[![Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lukmanovr/dkr/blob/main/homeworks/hw02_deep_models.ipynb){target="_blank"}

**≈ 5–10 hours · individual work · 10% of the course grade**

One notebook, three parts, covering multi-hop reasoning, the GCN's spectral
story, and the design space:

- **Part A · Derivations (30 pts).** Four short proofs, answered in markdown
  cells: boxes are closed under intersection (and points provably aren't
  enough) — the geometry behind Query2box
  ([Ren et al., 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.05969));
  the full eigenvalue computation of $\hat A$ on $C_4$, ending in "how many
  layers until 1% of the signal is left"; the static-attention theorem on two
  receivers; and which invariances mean/max aggregation buy — and when each is
  fatal.
- **Part B · Implementation (60 pts, autograded).** Three *deterministic*
  exercises — no training, no seed lottery: answer a two-hop conjunctive query
  with box geometry alone; measure the karate club's oversmoothing rate and
  match it to $|\lambda_2|$ to two decimals; and catch static attention
  experimentally — 100 random GATs, one constant argmax column each, then the
  GATv2 ([Brody et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.14491)) parameters that
  break the pattern.
- **Part C · Investigation (10 pts).** Extend the Week-7 ablation grid by one
  axis (BatchNorm, DropEdge, width, GATv2, or jumping knowledge) on the provided
  harness: hypothesis → cells with error bars → claims that cite them → scope.

Late policy: −10% per day, up to 3 days; nothing accepted after solutions are
released. Regrade window: one week after grades post.

## FAQ

**Can I hand-write Part A?** Yes — paste a *legible* photo into the markdown
cell. Illegible scans are graded as blank.

**Part B passes under SMOKE — is that enough?** The B checks are deterministic,
so SMOKE vs full makes no difference *there* — but Part C must be run full
(SMOKE shrinks epochs and seeds, and claims from SMOKE numbers score zero).

**My B2 rate is off by 0.05.** Almost always one of two slips: the karate club's
edges carry weights (`weight=None`!), or your $x^*$ projects onto the wrong
eigenvector — you want the eigenvector of the *largest* eigenvalue.

**May I use an AI assistant?** Yes, with disclosure in the final cell (tool +
what for), per the honor code. You must be able to explain any line and any
proof step in person; inability to explain is treated as undeclared use.

**Something is broken / ambiguous.** Post in the course forum thread for HW2 —
clarifications get pinned there, and everyone sees the same answers.
